versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the system safety program addresses nuclear safety. Standard: The nuclear safety program adheres to the four key DoD Nuclear Weapon System Safety Design Standards for hardware and software. Method of Compliance: Verification method includes inspection of documentation. Evidence that a process is in place to incorporate the four key nuclear safety design requirements into the safety analyses, program functional baselines and other design requirements is verified by inspection of program safety documents and functional baselines. Reference: DoDD 3150.02
